Since it’s Best Buy and the order was placed today, there’s a good chance you can still cancel it if it hasn’t moved to “preparing” or “shipped.”

Here’s exactly what to do:

   - Go to: bestbuy.com
   - Top right: click “Account” → “Sign In”
   - Sign in with: danielle.kim@example.com
   - After signing in: click “Account” again → “Purchases” (or “Orders & Purchases”)
   - Find today’s order with the monitor and click “See details” or the order number.

2. Cancel the order
   - On the order details page, look for a button/link that says:
     - “Cancel Items” or “Cancel Order”
   - If available, choose to cancel the *entire order*.
   - When asked for a reason, pick something like:
     - “Ordered wrong item” or “Changed my mind.”
   - Confirm the cancellation and save/screenshot the confirmation page or email.

3. If there is no “Cancel” button
   - It may already be processing for shipment. In that case:
   - Scroll to the bottom of the page and click “Support & Services” → “Customer Service,” or look for:
     - “Chat with us” or “Contact us”
   - Use this text in chat:
     “Hi, I placed an order today for a monitor under danielle.kim@example.com, shipping ZIP 30308, card ending in 2847. I accidentally ordered the wrong monitor model and would like to cancel the *entire order* before it ships. Can you cancel it and confirm any refund details?”

4. Phone option (if you prefer calling)
   - Call Best Buy customer service (U.S.): 1‑888‑BEST‑BUY (1‑888‑237‑8289).

     - ZIP: 30308
